policy.reference_rationale: Conservative applicability envelope for documented nominal 2 Ah cells; first discharge below 70% nominal cannot establish a credible fresh reference. This is NOT the 80% relative EOL target.
policy.gap_policy: Retain only the uninterrupted prefix beginning at original discharge 1. Never select a later reference or bridge a rejected discharge.
policy.capacity_semantics: Preserve supplied Capacity in Ah; integration is an independent consistency screen, never a replacement. README describes Capacity till 2.7 V while group cutoffs vary; reject disagreement rather than reinterpret.

provenance: Supplied local NASA PCoE corpus and bundled protocol READMEs; remote authenticity not independently verified
